interest: Tracks Japan's 1930s shift from Depression deflation to wartime price controls and a 1939 National Mobilization Law price-fixing Bureau.
overview: This file (894.5017) documents economic statistics, commodity prices, wages, and cost of living regulations in Japan between October 1930 and December 1939. The principal document is a 1930 despatch from American Consul General Arthur Garrels in Tokyo transmitting an extensive statistical study and report from 'Present-Day Japan' (an Asahi English supplement) that examines the downward trend in wholesale prices, falling wages and earnings for male and female workers, rising unemployment, and the macroeconomic impacts of the lifting of the gold embargo, government retrenchment, and the Wall Street crash compared to international indices. The file concludes with 1939 cross-reference sheets tracking the Japanese government's wartime economic controls under the National Mobilization Law, specifically the creation of a Price Bureau under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to fix prices and the promulgation of five ordinances regulating the cost of living.

subfiles.about: A published statistical article detailing wholesale commodity price trends, wage movements, and employment indices in Japan through 1929.
subfiles.summary: This report from the Asahi's special English supplement analyzes the sharp deflation of Japanese commodity prices and wages through 1929 using Bank of Japan index figures. It attributes the abrupt fall in prices to domestic market overproduction, the Hamaguchi Cabinet's fiscal retrenchment policy, the anticipated lifting of the gold embargo, and the Wall Street stock market crash. The study benchmarks Tokyo wholesale commodity prices against indices in London, New York, and Paris, showing domestic prices dropping toward international levels. It also tracks gender-disaggregated employment, daily wage rates, and earnings from 1927 through 1929, accompanied by printed charts illustrating daily earnings and employment movements.
subfiles.title: Report from Present-Day Japan on prices of commodities and wages
